messages.content: token-radar-01 iteration 2: deepen the working pipeline (better launch detection/scoring toward rank-1 metrics, alerting, polish), commit progress, prepare for eventual submit. No submit yet.

Research first: fetched the competition leaderboard. Rank key is judge win rate (Bradley-Terry over Swiss rounds), tie-break is artifact bytes (lower better). Rank 1 (nightshift-labs, ~96.2%) titles its entry 'the fitted model and its out-of-sample test on the board, traded tokens as anchors, costed farm timelines' - ranks 2-11 all repeat the comps-fitted/OOS-tested pattern. Decision: replace the fixed house constants with a model fitted on the snapshot's own trading tokens, plus a holdout test shown on the dashboard.

Wrote lib/model.ts changes: added Fit interface and fitModel() - collects anchors (protocols with mcap_usd>0, tvl>=1M, listed_at), regresses ln(mcap/tvl) on clamped 7-day growth and ln(age+30) by ordinary least squares (3x3 normal equations, Gauss elimination), one outlier trim pass at 1.5 log units, deterministic 20% holdout via slug hash. impliedValue() now scores implied = tvl x exp(b0 + b1*g + b2*ln(age+30)) when fitted, decomposed into base x growth x maturity multipliers so the dashboard recomputes the exact board number; house radar-1 constants remain the fallback under 10 anchors. Added buildAlerts(): watchlist TVL surges >=25%, launches <=45 days, out-of-floor movers >=60% into the top 50, capped at 12. Ran the pipeline: 200 rows, 40/40 watchlist, monotone ranks 1..N, fit succeeded (95 anchors, 39 train / 18 holdout, holdout median error 87%, in-sample 45%), 7 alerts.

Updated dashboard/app.js (impliedOf uses the fitted coefficients; methodology panel states the fitted formula, anchor counts, trim, holdout error; new alerts panel with clickable rows), app.css (alert styles), main.ts (fit summary line). Verified in headless chromium via playwright with zero console errors and screenshots that match the new board: detail modal for Steakhouse Financial recomputes $643.8M exactly as board.json carries; alerts panel shows 7 fresh-launch alerts; model panel shows the fitted formula and OOS numbers. Regenerated screenshots/1-board.png, 2-detail.png, 3-alerts.png (147-218 KiB, 1440x900), removed the stale 3-filtered.png. Self-checked the gate: 3 dashboard files, no network refs in src/href/import, ranks and farm-step constraints pass, dossier 908 KB <= 1.5 MiB. Updated README.md and DESIGN.md to the radar-2-fitted model. No submit: quota protocol requires second-eye approval and rank-1 alignment still has room (W3 dashboard polish planned).
